query getNotifications($limit: Int, $page_token: String, $update_last_seen: Boolean!) {
  getNotifications(
    limit: $limit
    page_token: $page_token
    update_last_seen: $update_last_seen
  ) {
    page_token
    last_seen
    unread
    notifications {
      ... on AddedNode {
        id
        notification_type
        created_at
        triggering_user {
          user_id
          full_name
          email
          snapshot_user_id
          __typename
        }
        added_node {
          node_id
          name
          type
          created_at
          owner_id
          snapshot_node_id
          __typename
        }
        added_node_type
        destination_folder {
          name
          node_id
          type
          created_at
          owner_id
          snapshot_node_id
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      ... on NewShare {
        id
        notification_type
        created_at
        triggering_user {
          user_id
          full_name
          email
          snapshot_user_id
          __typename
        }
        node {
          node_id
          name
          type
          created_at
          owner_id
          snapshot_node_id
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      ... on RemovedNode {
        id
        notification_type
        created_at
        triggering_user {
          user_id
          full_name
          email
          snapshot_user_id
          __typename
        }
        origin_folder {
          node_id
          name
          type
          created_at
          owner_id
          snapshot_node_id
          __typename
        }
        removed_node {
          node_id
          name
          type
          created_at
          owner_id
          snapshot_node_id
          __typename
        }
        removed_node_type
        __typename
      }
      ... on TransferredOwnership {
        id
        notification_type
        created_at
        triggering_user {
          user_id
          full_name
          email
          snapshot_user_id
          __typename
        }
        receiving_user {
          user_id
          full_name
          email
          snapshot_user_id
          __typename
        }
        number_of_nodes
        resulting_node {
          node_id
          name
          type
          created_at
          owner_id
          snapshot_node_id
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}
